children: Jake Schlicher, an officer serving as Chief Strategy Officer, reported a sale of Ferguson common stock on August 28, 2026. The reported sale used a volume-weighted average price of $230.92 per share (individual sale prices ranged between $230.92 and $230.93). The total reported sale amount was $1,195,472. After the transaction, Schlicher directly owned 9,490 shares of Ferguson common stock.
